status: unarmed: source review only; every stage needs its own fresh GO
token: <token: eight lowercase hex, minted at C0 admission>

observed_metadata.note: local metadata only; not a native observation of a running engine

stages.name: admission, no effect
stages.closure: helper-only: verify tranche sha, mint token, check control_paths/check_paths/check_profiles, write GO-bound intent
stages.failure: any refusal stops before C1; nothing to clean up
stages.retention: intent, GO copy, start --help stream, hashes under the run's private child

stages.name: fresh isolated engine start
stages.closure: waited exit 0 plus C2 identity check; any timeout or cap is Unknown and retained, never replayed
stages.failure: the zero-share form is verified at C0 from start --help; if it cannot be expressed, the only permitted share is the empty <control>/s and the GO must name it
stages.retention: start stream, PID, waited exit, profile YAML path only

stages.name: identity and read-only guest probe
stages.closure: check_engine and check_root pass; guest parent identity observed, not guessed
stages.failure: unreachable, changed or unknown state refuses; no start, reset or repair in this stage
stages.retention: status JSON, probe stream, uid/device/inode of the guest parent

stages.name: stage Dockerfile by reviewed helper
stages.closure: receipt check_receipt passes: sha, bytes, owner, fsynced, readback
stages.failure: partial or missing receipt refuses; the Unknown guest directory is retained, never reused

stages.name: one local-path runtime image build

env.DOCKER_CONFIG: <uncreated child of the owned guest context>

stages.closure: waited exit 0 and image ID from provenance; no check unless C4 closed
stages.failure: no retry; Unknown build is retained and never reaches C5
stages.retention: build stream, provenance file hash, image ID

stages.name: one disposable check

argv: <check: uid 0, python/SSL, GNU loader, coreutils versions>

stages.closure: container removed by --rm; waited exit 0 closes the stage
stages.failure: no retry; a leftover container with the planned name is retained, not removed by pattern

stages.name: retain and observe, no stop
stages.closure: observation only; the running VM is retained until a separate GO covers a stop

stages.name: admission and engine baseline (server reads, activation only)
stages.closure: check_desktop_resources sorts owned (exact label) from foreign; the baseline is recorded, not reset
stages.failure: a new Docker context is not an isolated engine: the baseline is what this stage observes, nothing more
stages.retention: all four streams, owned and foreign ID lists

stages.name: owned fixture volume
stages.closure: created volume label verified against the owned set
stages.failure: a name collision refuses; nothing is adopted
stages.retention: create stream, inspect of the owned volume

stages.name: runtime image into the Desktop engine

argv: helper-only: O_EXCL 0600 Dockerfile under <control>/d/ctx with receipt

stages.closure: image ID owned by its label; the image is not a reused tag
stages.failure: no retry; the Dockerfile receipt must match the Colima C3 bytes

stages.name: one disposable check on Desktop
stages.failure: no retry; leftovers retained by their owned label

stages.name: owned cleanup by exact ID only
stages.closure: post-cleanup baseline equals D0 foreign list
stages.failure: a foreign or unlabelled ID is never removed; prune is not used
stages.retention: cleanup streams, before and after baselines
